_about: Every allow hook, exemption, pre-strip, threshold, acknowledgement rule and one-click generator of the validators, the review, assembly and the fill. Each needs at least minBlock must-block cases tagged hook:<id> (expect BLOCK, NOT_OFFERED or REFUSED_*) and a test seam (core/validation/registry.ts HOOK_IDS + withHookDisabled) whose disabling turns at least one tagged PASS case red. Hooks marked 'removed' must never come back; their cases guard that. Add a hook here in the same commit that adds it to the product.

hooks.where: core/validation/opinion-language.ts (removed: NOTES_ABSENCE_SENTENCE, 4c8843e)
hooks.note: A 'No … was recorded' sentence stripped before the opinion check. Must never come back (R-safety-1).

hooks.where: core/validation/opinion-language.ts (removed: PAST_NARRATIVE_BEFORE / NARRATED_BACK_BEFORE, 4c8843e)
hooks.note: A narrated 'before returning / going back' accepted unless a deny-list word appears (R-safety-4).

hooks.where: core/validation/opinion-language.ts statusRecorded
hooks.note: 'Back to normal work/activity' accepted when a cited note records the return (fa14c72 tables, F1).

hooks.where: core/validation/opinion-language.ts (indexOf acceptance; WB replaces it with findAnchor)
hooks.note: An opinion phrase accepted when it appears in a cited note (N-ATTR-2: no goal, hedge, negation, modality or polarity check today).

hooks.where: core/validation/opinion-language.ts sameRestrictionWording
hooks.note: 'No restrictions' accepted when the note uses the same restriction wording.

hooks.where: core/validation/opinion-language.ts sameCausalWording
hooks.note: Causation wording accepted when the note uses the same causal wording.

hooks.where: core/validation/opinion-language.ts exerciseOnBalance
hooks.note: 'On balance' accepted when it is about balance exercises.

hooks.where: core/validation/opinion-language.ts (B2-1 'in X's opinion' / 'expect … to ease' acceptance)
hooks.note: An attributed opinion accepted when a cited note holds an opinion – must be a note THAT clinician wrote.

hooks.where: core/validation/voice.ts / core/voice.ts otherCliniciansInFirstPerson (licence (i): own notes; WB adds licence (ii), the possessive)
hooks.note: First person allowed only when every cited note is the voice owner's; a possessive that matches the owner named in a cited note may be acknowledged by the approver.

hooks.where: core/validation (WB) + review (WC): 'Accept as the note's words'
hooks.note: Khuram 26/10: the approver may accept with one click a drafted return-to-work / work-status line that their own note records. Nothing else.

hooks.where: core/validation/index.ts canAcknowledge (OPINION_LANGUAGE / OTHER_CLINICIAN_VOICE on edited text)
hooks.note: Edited text: the approver – and only the approver – may acknowledge (ackPolicy approver).

hooks.where: core/validation/opinion-language.ts + validation/voice.ts (origin 'clinician' is not checked)
hooks.note: Text counted as the clinician's own words skips the opinion and voice checks; only approver-stamped text may (C-ATTR-4, C-ATTR-5, R-safety-3).

hooks.where: ui/components/review (WC: 0.8 token overlap with any drafted sentence keeps drafted-text strictness; c1f774a's 30% rule is gone)
hooks.note: A drafted sentence kept, cut and pasted back, or changed by a word or a mark stays drafted text.

hooks.where: ui/components/review/review-model.ts settleGapsByAnswer (stop-gap c; WC replaces it with the approver rule)
hooks.note: A person's answer settles the box's gaps – never a clinician box's when the person is not the approver (NEW-1).

hooks.where: core/validation/index.ts runValidators (a not-applicable box's flags are dropped; WA1 drives it from the issue state)
hooks.note: Only a box that issues nothing drops its content checks; MISSING_PLACEHOLDER stays while a merge code would stay on the issued document (R-safety-2, R-safety-8).

hooks.where: core/conditions.ts conditionWanted / conditionOf (WA1 freezes conditions at creation)
hooks.note: A box ruled out by its condition prints nothing and drops its checks – the parser must read 'Only if … not …', lettered and 'either of the above' conditions right; unresolved means applicable.

hooks.where: ui/components/review/review-model.ts nameClinicianFix / core/voice.ts nameClinicianInstead
hooks.note: 'Name X instead' – only when every cited note is X's and no own-opinion wording is present; never moves the approver's opinion onto someone else.

hooks.where: (removed: 'Use my name', 4c8843e)
hooks.note: Must never be offered on a clinical act (R-safety-5).

hooks.where: ai/assemble.ts held-back choice suggestedAnswer + issues.tsx 'Tick “…”'
hooks.note: A one-click tick: never on a clinician_opinion or physio_choice box (C-2), never from an unrelated duration (R-safety-7), never on a grade scale, never for staff.

hooks.where: ui/components/review/review-model.ts removeAbsenceSentences ('Remove it')
hooks.note: Removes 'not recorded' wording the answer now covers – never a clinical negative finding (R-regression-5).

hooks.where: core/voice.ts rewriteInFirstPerson ('Write in my own voice')
hooks.note: Only the owner's own name becomes 'I'; never a GP's or colleague's act (C-1); never on a colleague's note.

hooks.where: core/validation/draft-fit.ts repeats + review fixes (WD: whole sentences only, figures kept)
hooks.note: Removing a repeated sentence never splits a number or abbreviation, never orphans 'He recorded', never removes initial/current findings (B3-2, R-regression-3, R-regression-4, B3-5).

hooks.where: ai/assemble.ts compact-cell value extraction (WD: hidden when the paragraph cites another clinician's note)
hooks.note: A compact answer never strips 'assessed by <colleague>' (C-REV-1).

hooks.where: core/voice.ts plainClinicalWording at assembly (WD stops running it automatically)
hooks.note: 'On … I recorded that X' never becomes a bare 'X' that hides who recorded it (B3-4).

hooks.where: ai/assemble.ts META_WORDING (WD narrows it and holds back instead of dropping)
hooks.note: Drafting meta-wording holds back the sentence; never drops a paragraph or invents a 'No clinician recorded an opinion' gap (R-regression-1).

hooks.where: core/scope.ts removeSentencesWithTerms (WD: the shared tokenizer, notes policy)
hooks.note: Scope minimisation never cuts a figure ('PSFS 6.5' never becomes 'PSFS 6') (N-1).

hooks.where: ui/components/review/box-items.ts leaveOptionalBoxesBlank
hooks.note: 'Leave optional boxes blank' – optional boxes only (B2-26), never a clinician box for staff, never a box whose merge code would stay printed.

hooks.where: forms/docx-fill.ts leftBlank handling (WA2: fill outcomes, strict FINAL)
hooks.note: A box left blank on a FINAL copy prints nothing: no pre-printed mark, tick, option list, default, frame or merge code.

hooks.where: core/form-map-lint.ts lintFormMap (FormField.lintAccepted; L5 at /forms/confirm and a store PUT to confirmed, server-stamped by a clinician member)
hooks.note: A map-lint finding the field's lintAccepted covers (same rule, same field) is listed as accepted, never as an error. It never covers another rule, another field, or a map-level finding.
